info.description: Unified API for Australian public economic data.

503.description: Redis or another required dependency is unavailable.

204.description: Subscription revoked without deleting audit history.

ApsSnapshotSummary.description: Compact APS point returned by history endpoints.

as_of.description: End of the represented Sydney calendar day, expressed in UTC.

confidence_band.description: Missing-input lower and upper APS bounds.

config_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonical config JSON.

score.description: Numeric APS value only when coverage gates pass.

snapshot_date.description: Sydney calendar date represented by this publication.

supersedes_snapshot_id.description: Prior snapshot revision superseded by this correction.

trend.description: Movement against the nearest comparable numeric snapshot.

oneOf.description: Score zone only when coverage gates pass.

Axis.description: Scorecard axis used by APS v1.

Code.description: A single code within a codelist (e.g. `VIC` → "Victoria").

codelist_id.description:
The codelist this code belongs to. Denormalised here so a `Code`
emitted from the API is self-contained.

oneOf.description:
Optional parent code id for hierarchical codelists (e.g. regions with
state → LGA containment).

CodeId.description: Identifier for a code within a codelist (e.g. `VIC`).

Codelist.description: A reusable vocabulary of codes attached to dimensions.

score.description: Component score in the axis scale.

Confidence.description: Confidence label exposed for configs, contributions, and snapshots.

CoverageThresholds.description: Coverage gates required for a numeric APS publication.

axis_pct.description: Minimum usable scored weight percentage on each axis.

overall_pct.description: Minimum overall usable scored weight percentage.

dataflow_ids.description: Optional dataflow filter. Empty means every dataflow update.

url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) URL to receive webhook deliveries.

signing_secret.description: HMAC signing secret shown exactly once.

Dataflow.description: A dataflow — a named collection of series sharing dimensions and measures.

attribution.description: Required attribution string shown to end-users alongside derived charts.

dimensions.description: Ordered list of dimension ids that key series within this dataflow.

measures.description: Measures published by this dataflow (index, rate, count, ...).

codelist.description: Codelist attached to the requested dimension.

dimensions.description: Ordered dimension metadata for the dataflow.

dataflows.description: Matching dataflows, ordered by source then dataflow id.

DependencyHealth.description: One dependency status in the production readiness response.

latency_ms.description: Probe latency in whole milliseconds when a probe was attempted.

Dimension.description:
A single dimension within a dataflow. Binds a dimension id to a codelist
that enumerates the permitted values.

position.description:
Position of this dimension in the dataflow's canonical dimension order.
Adapters must emit dimensions in this order so series-key derivation is
stable across codebases (see `Spec.md § Data model`).

DimensionId.description: Identifier for a dimension within a dataflow (e.g. `region`).

Direction.description: Direction used to normalize raw indicator values.

Frequency.description:
Cadence at which a dataflow publishes new observations. Informational —
used by the scheduler to pick discovery intervals and by the SLO alerting
rule `dataflow-no-new-observations`.

HealthDependencies.description: Dependency collection in the production readiness response.

HistoryView.description: Revision view used by APS history reads.

IndicatorConfig.description: Static config for one APS indicator.

dimension_selector.description: Exact dimension selector for the intended APS series.

hard_after_seconds.description: Age in seconds after which the value is excluded from scoring.

soft_after_seconds.description: Age in seconds after which the value remains usable but becomes stale.

weight.description: Scored weight within the axis. Visible-unscored inputs may use zero.

dimensions.description: Dimension selector used for this input.

ingestion_generation_id.description: Ingestion generation that published the resolved observation.

normalized_value.description: Normalized value in the axis scale, when scored.

source_artifact_id.description: Resolved source artifact id, when available.

oneOf.description: Escape hatch for licenses not yet enumerated. Carries the SPDX-style id.

other.description: Escape hatch for licenses not yet enumerated. Carries the SPDX-style id.

License.description:
Canonical license identifier. Ingestion refuses to load a dataflow whose
`license` field is absent (see `Spec.md § Data licensing and attribution`).

ListSubscriptionsResponse.description: Collection response for subscriptions owned by one API key.

subscriptions.description: Subscriptions owned by the authenticated key.

Normalization.description: Linear normalization references for one indicator.

best.description: Best reference value for this indicator.

worst.description: Worst reference value for this indicator.

Observation.description: One observation — a single row in the `observations` hypertable.

attributes.description:
Free-form attributes attached to this observation (e.g. SDMX `OBS_STATUS`
or adapter-specific annotations).

revision_no.description: `0` for the original publication; `N` for the Nth revision.

ObservationStatus.description:
Observation status flags sourced from SDMX. Subset in use across Australian
publishers; extend as new codes appear in upstream feeds.

ObservationsMetadata.description: Attribution and licensing metadata that applies to an observations page.

attribution.description: Required source acknowledgement to display with derived charts.

source_url.description: Canonical citation URL for the upstream source.

observations.description: Observation rows in ascending `(time, series_key)` order.

attributes.description: Free-form source attributes for this observation.

dimensions.description: Series dimension values keyed by dimension id.

revision_no.description: Revision number, where zero is the original publication.

value.description: Numeric value; null when status is `missing`.

PaginationMetadata.description: Cursor metadata for the current observations page.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when the page is complete.

status.description: HTTP status code for this problem.

Provenance.description: Source and licensing metadata for a scorecard input.

attribution.description: Attribution text shown in API/UI responses.

license.description: License identifier or source-specific license note.

retrieved_at.description: Optional retrieval date for curated/manual inputs.

reviewed_at.description: Optional review date for curated/manual inputs.

reviewed_by.description: Optional reviewer identifier for curated/manual inputs.

source_url.description: Canonical source URL for this input.

PublicationState.description: Snapshot publication result after applying coverage gates.

PublishedApsSnapshot.description: Immutable APS API snapshot persisted as one publication revision.

as_of.description: End of the represented Sydney calendar day, expressed in UTC.

confidence_band.description: Missing-input lower and upper APS bounds.

config_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonical config JSON.

score.description: Numeric APS value only when coverage gates pass.

snapshot_date.description: Sydney calendar date represented by this publication.

supersedes_snapshot_id.description: Prior snapshot revision superseded by this correction.

trend.description: Movement against the nearest comparable numeric snapshot.

oneOf.description: Score zone only when coverage gates pass.

RotateSubscriptionSecretResponse.description: One-time secret returned by a rotation command.

signing_secret.description: New signing secret shown exactly once.

oneOf.description: Dependency details. Liveness omits dependency probes.

version.description: Immutable build version or git SHA.

ScorecardConfig.description: APS config metadata and indicator list.

attribution.description: Attribution note for the derived scorecard config.

digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonical config with this field empty.

license.description: License note for the derived scorecard config.

trend_threshold.description: Absolute movement required for an up/down trend.

ScorecardConfigQuery.description: Query string selecting an immutable APS config version.

version.description: Config version; omitted selects the current version.

ScorecardHistoryQuery.description: Query string for APS history snapshots.

since.description: Inclusive lower snapshot date in `YYYY-MM-DD` form.

until.description: Inclusive upper snapshot date in `YYYY-MM-DD` form.

view.description: Revision view, defaulting to original as-published values.

ScorecardLatestQuery.description: Query string for the latest APS snapshot.

view.description: Revision view, defaulting to original as-published values.

ScorecardSnapshot.description: Full APS snapshot produced by the pure scorer.

as_of.description: Snapshot timestamp or date chosen by the caller.

config_version.description: Config version used for the score.

latest_period.description: Latest period represented by resolved inputs.

trend.description: Trend relative to prior comparable score.

limit.description: Maximum number of catalog results to return.

q.description: Search text. Blank queries are rejected.

query.description: Normalized query text used for ranking.

dataflow_ids.description: Dataflows directly represented by this match.

score.description: Relevance score. Larger scores rank first.

SearchResultKind.description: Catalog object types returned by search.

Series.description:
One time series within a dataflow. `dimensions` is the sorted bag of
`(key, value)` pairs that, together with `dataflow_id` and `measure_id`,
seeds `series_key`.

active.description:
Whether the upstream source still publishes this series. Inactive
series are retained for historical queries but excluded from the
default `/v1/series` listing.

dimensions.description:
Dimension values keyed by typed dimension ids and code ids. Stored
sorted (via `BTreeMap`) so iteration order is stable across
serialisation + re-hashing.

propertyNames.description: Identifier for a dimension within a dataflow (e.g. `region`).

oneOf.description: Latest observation by timestamp and highest revision for that timestamp.

SeriesRevisionMetadata.description: Revision details for the latest observation returned with a series lookup.

is_revision.description: Whether this observation supersedes the original publication.

revision_no.description: Latest revision number for the observation timestamp.

source_artifact_id.description: Source artifact that produced this revision.

coverage_state.description: Coverage state exposed to catalog consumers.

fixture_reference.description: Repository-relative representative fixture or reviewed snapshot.

oneOf.description: Soft and hard freshness thresholds for active sources.
Upstream timeout and rate policy for active sources.
Durable discovery schedule for active sources.
Range, cardinality, and partial-row policy for active sources.

SourceCatalogEntry.description: One source and its governed dataflows.

hard_after_seconds.description: Age in seconds after which data is hard-expired.

soft_after_seconds.description: Age in seconds after which data is soft-stale.

SourceId.description: Identifier for an upstream data source (e.g. `abs`, `rba`, `apra`).

max_series_cardinality.description: Maximum series cardinality for one generation.

sources.description: Governed sources ordered by source id.

confidence_band.description: Axis confidence band in the axis scale.

score.description: Axis score (`0..1` for throughput, `-1..1` for orientation).

weight.description: Expected scored weight for this axis.

dataflow_ids.description: Dataflow filter attached to the subscription.

TimePrecision.description:
Temporal granularity of an observation's timestamp. Matches the SDMX
`@FREQ` facet on a coarse scale.

Trend.description: Trend arrow comparing the latest score to a prior comparable snapshot.

ZoneThresholds.description: Inclusive upper bounds for the first two APS zones.
